/*
================================================================================
项目：蜡笔小新 10-10 看点关卡疑似卡关流失玩家
查询窗口：2026-07-29 ~ 2026-07-30
判定：
  1. 目标关卡为 stage_name_real IN ('10-10-1','10-10-2','10-10-3','10-10-4')；
  2. 任一目标关卡累计挑战 >= 2 次，作为“疑似卡关”代理；
  3. 玩家最后一次主线挑战仍停在上述四关之一；
  4. 最近一次有效活跃距离查询时点 >= 120 分钟。
说明：没有真实战斗胜负字段，因此不能证明玩家因失败退出。
================================================================================
*/
WITH UserBlacklist AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT "#user_id" AS user_id
    FROM user_result_cluster_18
    WHERE cluster_name IN ('internal_users', 'is_windows', 'is_water')
),
CohortUsers AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT v."#account_id" AS account_id
    FROM ta.v_event_18 v
    LEFT JOIN UserBlacklist b ON v."#user_id" = b.user_id
    WHERE v."$part_event" = 'new_role'
      AND v."$part_date" BETWEEN '2026-07-29' AND '2026-07-30'
      AND v."#account_id" IS NOT NULL
      AND b.user_id IS NULL
),
StageMap AS (
    SELECT
        TRY_CAST("stage_id@stage_id" AS BIGINT) AS stage_id,
        MAX("stage_id@stage_name_real") AS stage_name_real,
        MAX("stage_id@stage_name_show") AS stage_name_show
    FROM ta_dim.dim_18_0_52765
    GROUP BY 1
),
MainStageEvents AS (
    SELECT
        v."#account_id" AS account_id,
        CAST(v."#event_time" AS TIMESTAMP) AS event_time,
        TRY_CAST(v.role_lev AS INTEGER) AS role_level,
        m.stage_id,
        m.stage_name_real,
        m.stage_name_show
    FROM ta.v_event_18 v
    INNER JOIN CohortUsers c ON v."#account_id" = c.account_id
    LEFT JOIN UserBlacklist b ON v."#user_id" = b.user_id
    INNER JOIN StageMap m
      ON m.stage_id = COALESCE(TRY_CAST(v.a_rst[1].id AS BIGINT), TRY_CAST(v.stage_id AS BIGINT))
    WHERE v."#event_name" = 'stage_fight'
      AND TRY_CAST(v.a_rst[1].key AS INTEGER) = 1001
      AND v."$part_date" BETWEEN '2026-07-29' AND '2026-07-30'
      AND b.user_id IS NULL
),
LatestMainStage AS (
    SELECT account_id, stage_id, stage_name_real, stage_name_show, event_time AS last_stage_time
    FROM (
        SELECT
            e.*,
            ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
                PARTITION BY account_id
                ORDER BY event_time DESC, stage_id DESC
            ) AS rn
        FROM MainStageEvents e
    ) ranked
    WHERE rn = 1
),
TargetStageCounts AS (
    SELECT
        account_id,
        stage_name_real,
        COUNT(*) AS attempts,
        MIN(event_time) AS first_attempt_time,
        MAX(event_time) AS last_attempt_time,
        MAX(role_level) AS max_role_level
    FROM MainStageEvents
    WHERE stage_name_real IN ('10-10-1', '10-10-2', '10-10-3', '10-10-4')
    GROUP BY 1, 2
),
TargetRetryProfile AS (
    SELECT
        account_id,
        MAX(attempts) AS max_single_stage_attempts,
        SUM(attempts) AS total_target_attempts,
        MIN(first_attempt_time) AS first_target_attempt_time,
        MAX(last_attempt_time) AS last_target_attempt_time,
        MAX(max_role_level) AS max_role_level
    FROM TargetStageCounts
    GROUP BY 1
),
LastActivity AS (
    SELECT
        v."#account_id" AS account_id,
        MAX(CAST(v."#event_time" AS TIMESTAMP)) AS last_active_time
    FROM ta.v_event_18 v
    INNER JOIN CohortUsers c ON v."#account_id" = c.account_id
    LEFT JOIN UserBlacklist b ON v."#user_id" = b.user_id
    WHERE v."$part_date" BETWEEN '2026-07-29' AND '2026-07-30'
      AND v."$part_event" <> 'daily_role_snapshot'
      AND b.user_id IS NULL
    GROUP BY 1
),
CandidateUsers AS (
    SELECT
        r.account_id,
        l.stage_id AS last_stage_id,
        l.stage_name_real AS last_stage_name_real,
        l.stage_name_show AS last_stage_name_show,
        r.max_single_stage_attempts,
        r.total_target_attempts,
        r.first_target_attempt_time,
        r.last_target_attempt_time,
        a.last_active_time,
        DATE_DIFF(
            'minute',
            a.last_active_time,
            CAST(CURRENT_TIMESTAMP AT TIME ZONE 'Asia/Shanghai' AS TIMESTAMP)
        ) AS inactive_minutes,
        r.max_role_level,
        CASE WHEN r.max_single_stage_attempts >= 2 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS has_retry_2plus,
        CASE WHEN l.stage_name_real IN ('10-10-1', '10-10-2', '10-10-3', '10-10-4') THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS final_stage_is_target,
        CASE WHEN DATE_DIFF(
            'minute',
            a.last_active_time,
            CAST(CURRENT_TIMESTAMP AT TIME ZONE 'Asia/Shanghai' AS TIMESTAMP)
        ) >= 120 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS inactive_2h
    FROM TargetRetryProfile r
    INNER JOIN LatestMainStage l ON r.account_id = l.account_id
    INNER JOIN LastActivity a ON r.account_id = a.account_id
)
SELECT
    account_id AS "账号ID",
    last_stage_id AS "最后主线关卡ID",
    last_stage_name_real AS "最后主线关卡",
    last_stage_name_show AS "最后主线显示名",
    max_single_stage_attempts AS "单个10-10关卡最高挑战次数",
    total_target_attempts AS "10-10四关总挑战次数",
    CAST(first_target_attempt_time AS VARCHAR) AS "首次挑战10-10时间",
    CAST(last_target_attempt_time AS VARCHAR) AS "最后挑战10-10时间",
    CAST(last_active_time AS VARCHAR) AS "最后活跃时间",
    inactive_minutes AS "距今未活跃分钟",
    ROUND(inactive_minutes / 60.0, 2) AS "距今未活跃小时",
    max_role_level AS "挑战期间最高等级",
    has_retry_2plus AS "任一目标关挑战至少2次",
    final_stage_is_target AS "最后主线仍在10-10四关",
    inactive_2h AS "已停活至少2小时",
    CASE
        WHEN has_retry_2plus = 1 AND final_stage_is_target = 1 AND inactive_2h = 1 THEN 1
        ELSE 0
    END AS "疑似10-10卡关流失"
FROM CandidateUsers
ORDER BY "疑似10-10卡关流失" DESC, "距今未活跃分钟" DESC, "单个10-10关卡最高挑战次数" DESC;
